text:
Name: Wheat flour
Also known as: wheat, flour, enriched wheat flour, whole wheat flour
E-number: N/A
Category: grain / base ingredient
Function: Provides structure, texture and bulk in baked and processed foods.
Common uses: Bread, pasta, crackers, breading/coatings, thickeners in sauces.
Allergen information: Contains gluten. Direct allergen: wheat. Also relevant to people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.
Health considerations: A source of carbohydrates and some protein. Refined wheat flour has less fiber than whole wheat flour.
Source: Codex Alimentarius / FDA Food Labeling Guide (general food composition references)

Name: E415 - Xanthan gum
Also known as: xanthan gum, E415
E-number: E415
Category: food additive - thickener/stabilizer
Function: Thickening and stabilizing agent produced by bacterial fermentation of sugars.
